root_motivation: **Who:** the agent building on mcphost. **What:** one machine-readable list of every error code with class, family and remedy. **Why not today:** codes live in four hand-written places that disagree; /help covers 21 of ~250.
user_persona: An agent that reads /errors.json or host.errors once, then branches on class and remedy instead of matching error messages.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given src/**/*.rs, When the scan collects every code literal and AppError::code() arm, Then each is a row of ERROR_CODES and a format!-built code fails the test.
Given an error of any registry code raised through into_error_data, When the client reads data, Then it carries class, family, remedy and help_url equal to the registry row.
Given an anonymous GET /errors.json, When parsed, Then codes is sorted, every row has the seven fields, classes lists the enum's variant names, and version equals the crate version.

Given host.errors with no code from an anonymous connection and a keyed tenant, When called, Then both equal /errors.json; Given code tool_excepton, Then tool_not_found with did_you_mean tool_exception.

scope: src/error_registry.rs (new): ERROR_CODES, ErrorClass, Family, catalog_json(), call().
src/errors.rs, src/help.rs, src/http.rs: class/family/remedy/help_url in error data, /help/<code> and GET /errors.json from the registry.
non_goals: Renaming any code; changing JSON-RPC numeric codes; a per-tenant error log; retiring HELP_CODES (P0 R5 beyond AC2), is_5xx_class_error (R6), docs_anchor resolution test (R7), llms.txt line (R8).

additional.engine_form: mcphost-qjs subprocess in the python bwrap profile; cold_p95_ms measured by jsk_ac01

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not list the host's error codes?
five_whys_trace.a: They are spread over AppError::code(), 119 literals, 16 HELP_CODES and a 7-code allowlist.

ambiguities_resolved.question: did_you_mean for a near-miss code: string or list?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: A string (the nearest code), per the AC's literal did_you_mean: "tool_exception"; nearest[] carries up to three.
